response.sql: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CASE WHEN TRIM(product_quantity) = '' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(product_quantity AS REAL) END) AS average_quantity, AVG(1.0 * (derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS average_quantity FROM invoice_averages) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.average_quantity, i.cost_ratio, i.average_quantity - o.average_quantity AS quantity_difference FROM invoice_averages AS i CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE i.average_quantity > o.average_quantity ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Nonblank product_quantity values are numeric text; blank values are treated as missing. Lines with zero derived_total_cost have an undefined ratio and are excluded from that average.
